root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic orientations: elevation or being above, and return or recurrence after an interval.
root_idea.development: The elevation branch extends from physical position to superiority, excess, and domination. A related recurrent-return branch describes milk returning to the udder, intervals between milkings, recovery of health or awareness, and actions performed piecemeal.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic Form IV verb is a distinct lexical item meaning to recover.
The Quranic interval noun is displayed with its attested vocalic variant.
The nominal occurrences are displayed under the normalized citation form فَوْق.
The LOC-tagged occurrences are syntactic uses of the same lexical item فَوْق and are merged with the nominal form.

senses.definition: To recover; to return to a sound state of body, mind, or awareness.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of recovery from illness, intoxication, a swoon, or loss of reason; the Quranic occurrence describes recovery after a state of overwhelming collapse.

senses.definition: A pause, respite, or return; in the Quranic expression, no respite or recurrence is granted.
senses.usage_conditions: The verse is read with either فَوَاقٍ or فُوَاقٍ. Interpretations include no delay, no waiting, no pause comparable to the interval between milkings, and no return or repetition.

senses.definition: Above, over, or on top of something; the upper side or direction relative to another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used spatially and directionally, including movement or arrival from an upper side. It may function as an adverb of place or as a preposition with a following noun or pronoun.

senses.definition: More than, exceeding, or beyond another amount, number, or comparative measure.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in numerical and comparative expressions. In فَمَا فَوْقَهَا, the phrase denotes what lies beyond the comparison in scale; the reported interpretations concern greater or lesser size, not an independent general meaning “below.”

senses.definition: Higher or superior in rank, status, merit, or station.
senses.usage_conditions: Applies to worldly or eschatological standing and to one party being raised above another in degree.

senses.definition: Over, in the sense of exercising mastery, power, or dominance over others.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in constructions describing authority, conquest, or prevailing power rather than merely physical location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To surpass, excel, or be higher than another; to overcome someone in an argument.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb used of a person surpassing companions or others in eminence, dignity, nobility, or excellence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hiccup, pant, or experience an involuntary rising or repeated sound of breath from the chest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related noun may denote the wind, sobbing, or short breathing itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be at the point of death or give up the spirit; in some reports, to die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also describes the gasping or breath-catching condition associated with dying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to have milk collected in the udder between two milkings or to reach the time for milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related usage may describe her being brought back from pasture and left to rest so that the milk returns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break; of an arrow, for its notch to break, split, or crack.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive use may mean to break a thing, especially the notch of an arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or judge someone superior or excellent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II usage corresponding to making another person excel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give or draw out accumulated milk in successive portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of giving a young camel the milk collected between milkings; by extension, supplies may be given repeatedly rather than all at once.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a notch in an arrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is an arrow being prepared for use with a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a reported figurative usage, to slit the vulva.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an attributed tropical usage and is kept separate from the arrow-notch meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rest or interval between two milkings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported noun usage connected with the period in which milk is allowed to collect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to rest or recover her milk after grazing, so that it returns to the udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the camel being brought back and left until the milk is restored.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a season or time to become abundant in herbage after barrenness or drought.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV usage of renewed abundance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put an arrow’s notch onto the bowstring in preparation for shooting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related form أَوْفَقَهُ is also reported for this action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exalt oneself above a people or party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reflexive Form V usage describing self-elevation over a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take, draw, or consume something in successive portions rather than all at once.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used literally of a young camel drinking accumulated milk and of milking a camel repeatedly; also of drinking a beverage piecemeal and, figuratively, reciting or performing something in portions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break or become broken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive Form VII usage corresponding to breaking a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to become lean or emaciated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-related usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perish or die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as another Form VII usage, especially of a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become poor, needy, or in want.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source explicitly distinguishes this Form VIII verb from the unaugmented verb فَاقَ in this sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die while experiencing repeated hiccupping, gasping, or short catching of the breath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported usage associated with the respiratory condition at death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To delay milking a she-camel until her milk collects in the udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The imperative is used to tell someone not to milk the camel before the proper time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep drinking without abstaining or without restricting drinking to an appointed time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of continuous drinking of wine or another beverage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large bowl or dish filled with food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare nominal usage identified with a large جَفْنَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cooked olive oil; a variant explanation gives fresh olive oil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The alternatives occur in the interpretation of a poetic expression and are reported as lexical explanations rather than a single settled identification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The desert or a certain broad, open tract of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun attributed to named authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Oil of ben, or a comb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are alternative explanations reported for the word in a cited verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The notch of an arrow where the bowstring is placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may be masculine or feminine; its dual can denote the two cusps of the notch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A complete share, and figuratively a person’s share or degree of good fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The metaphor derives from an arrow complete with its notch; related expressions can describe the largest religious share or an incomplete share of fortune.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A course, way, or manner of action or speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Conventional expressions use the word for attending to one’s affair, entering a manner of speech, taking the first way, or returning to a former state of close communion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bout or discharge of shooting in one direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for shooting one round or one directional volley.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In idioms, a first shot associated with dying, death, or departure without return.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported expressions describe a person as dying, being choked without recovery, or going away and not returning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vulva or the rima of the vulva.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical metaphor comparing the opening with an arrow notch; the identification is attributed and not the ordinary meaning of the headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Possibly the front edge of the lobe of the ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source marks this identification as tentative and raises the possibility of a transcription error.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The opening of the mouth, or the extremity of the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported anatomical usage for an opening or extremity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The uppermost part of the penis or the glans.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported anatomical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Poverty, want, or need.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun used in expressions for a person who is in need; it has no unaugmented verb in this sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The milk collected in a she-camel’s udder between two milkings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is reported as originally containing و and has several plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water gathered in clouds and then released as rain, especially in successive falls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural usage connected with repeated accumulation and release.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The greater part, or successive portions, of the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing departure after much or several portions of the night have passed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A period of the forenoon, either its early portion or the time when the sun has risen high.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The authorities differ over which portion of the ضحى is intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Upper, superior, or relating to what is above.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from فَوْق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An upper garment worn over the clothing next to the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later or dialectal clothing term, especially an ample long upper coat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The returning supply of milk after sucking or milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This vocalization denotes the return of milk, distinct from the interval noun used in the Quranic reading discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interval between two milkings or two suckings; by extension, a very short time or quick action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The interval may be understood as the return of milk to the udder or the pause between grasping and releasing the udder. In a reported idiomatic interpretation it can mean proceeding quickly or distributing with unequal distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Superior, excellent, surpassing, or choice and pure in its kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of people or things, including excellence in knowledge, wealth, beauty, or quality; the plural may refer to elegant scholars or orators.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The junction of the neck with the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The anatomical term is associated with a long neck when the junction is high.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow whose notch is broken or absent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figuratively, an expression involving such an arrow denotes an incomplete share of good fortune or disappointment in attaining one’s aim.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A glans whose extremity tapers to a point.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel whose udder contains milk collected between two milkings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form and plural forms are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a poet, exceptionally or wonderfully eloquent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage equating the word with an admirable poetizer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or drink taken little by little.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial adjective describing consumption in successive portions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow provided with a notch and having the bowstring placed in it for shooting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can also be used figuratively in a blessing about being rightly prepared for generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who sleeps much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare and explicitly marked unusual usage.

cautions: فَوَاقٌ and فُوَاقٌ are reported as alternative Quranic readings at 38:15; their interpretations overlap but include slightly different emphases on delay, return, and the interval between milkings.
The reported anatomical sense of فُوقٌ referring to the ear edge is explicitly tentative, and the source itself raises the possibility of a transcription error.
Several rare Classical meanings are attributed to particular authorities or marked as tropical; they are retained as Classical evidence but are not treated as Quranic senses.
